title: Implement Immediate Turd Pickup and Interaction Feedback
objective: Add toilet targeting, animated pickup presentation, STEAL TURD prompting, +1/counter/exit HUD feedback, and deterministic presentation state while preserving immediate TB-R06 trigger and final-exit authority.
acceptance: TurdToilet exposes set_targeted(), targeted, pickup_feedback_active, and pickup_duration from 0.15 through 0.35 seconds; only an uncollected turd can be targeted
a successful collect sets has_turd false and emits collected exactly once synchronously, begins a visible pickup Tween, and every immediate duplicate returns false without restarting feedback
the existing player nearest-target path owns exactly one active collectible target, clears old/out-of-range targets, ignores empty/collected toilets, and preserves interaction range and movement
the active prompt is exactly E — STEAL TURD and is hidden for empty, collected, out-of-range, and completed-heist states
each successful collection immediately updates the counter, shows +1 TURD once, punches the counter once, and exposes deterministic feedback counts; rejected collection produces no HUD feedback

at restroom_004 collect_count threshold two, count and trigger fire synchronously, Door A begins opening while pickup_feedback_active remains true, and repeated collection leaves count/trigger/open/HUD counts unchanged
remaining restroom_004 thresholds fire once, final EXIT UNLOCKED feedback occurs once, final exit unlock and heist completion remain functional
restroom_001 through restroom_004, TB-001, TB-002, TB-003, TB-H01, TB-R01, TB-R02, TB-R03, TB-R03A, TB-R04 identity, TB-R04B, TB-R04C, and TB-R06 all pass
normal, targeted, pickup, HUD, final-exit, and door-threshold rendered evidence, Godot validation, Linux export, and exported execution of all four levels pass
tests, levels, schema, scenes, doors/triggers, character, movement, camera, collision, audio, assets, and unrelated gameplay do not change
